result.title: RadarDINO: Distilling a Visual Foundation Model into mmWave Radar for Human Mesh Reconstruction
result.summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar offers a privacy-preserving and illumination-robust alternative for human mesh reconstruction (HMR). However, high-fidelity radar HMR remains challenging. Sparse point cloud-based methods suffer from information loss and missed detections, while raw radar tensor methods like RT-Mesh lack fine-grained semantics and explicit local body modeling. In this paper, we propose RadarDINO, a radar HMR framework that distills visual semantics from a DINOv3 teacher into 3D radar representations and introduces explicit geometric supervision. DINOv3 descriptors are transferred to radar voxels via calibrated RGB-radar geometry, providing voxel- and body-part-level supervision for part-aware radar representations. We further incorporate vertex- and joint-losses to directly constrain reconstructed geometry. On the M4Human dataset, our method outperforms the SOTA baseline across all three evaluation splits.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RadarDINO：借助标定的 RGB-雷达几何，把 DINOv3 视觉描述子迁移到雷达体素上，提供体素级与身体部位级的语义监督，并叠加顶点与关节损失直接约束几何，以提升毫米波雷达人体网格重建。
AI.relevance_reason: 把视觉基础模型的部位级语义蒸馏进另一模态的内部表征作为辅助监督，可能可供核查是否有助于缓解 LVR 中视觉细节在 latent 状态里坍缩的问题；但该工作面向雷达 HMR，不涉及推理期状态生成，迁移性需自行判断。
